legacy_c5_yi.program:
def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    people = image_patch.find("person")
    if not people: return image_patch
    people.sort(key=lambda p: p.compute_depth(), reverse=True)
    facing_us = [p for p in people if p.horizontal_center == image_patch.horizontal_center]
    red_coats = [p for p in facing_us if p.verify_property("person", "red coat")]
    return red_coats[0] if red_coats else facing_us[0] if facing_us else people[0]
